name: Phoberos
description: A harsh badlands region on Theros inhabited by outcast minotaur raiders, a contested borderland between Akros and Skophos.

timeline.summary: Penthikos breaks formation in the Phoberos badlands and charges ahead alone.
timeline.quote: Breaking formation and running ahead, he struck down enemies as fast as they came at him

citation.text: "Penthikos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Akroan ranks fall into disorder and drown under the advancing Returned while Penthikos is cut off.
timeline.quote: he heard his shieldmates curse him as they died

citation.text: "Penthikos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Humans and minotaurs wage war over the badlands; Iroas and Mogis and their champions fight, founding Akros and Skophos with Phoberos as border.
timeline.quote: This conflict resulted in the founding of Akros and Skophos
